The '''''Sheathipede''-class Type B shuttle''', also known simply as the '''Class Type B shuttle''', was a model of cargo [[shuttle]] manufactured by [[Haor Chall Engineering Corporation]] and used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles" /> At least [[Shuttle 81572|one]] was captured by the [[Galactic Republic]].<ref name="The Citadel">{{TCW|The Citadel (episode)}}</ref>

==History==
Around [[20 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the [[mission to Mortis]] and the [[Battle of Mon Cala]] in [[20 BBY]]. As the episode this event takes place within takes place between the events of the episodes the other events are attached to according to {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-chronological-episodeorder|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Chronological Episode Order}}, this event must also take place in 20 BBY.</ref> [[Shuttle 81572]] was used by a Jedi strike team led by [[Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[clone trooper]] [[officer]]s [[Clone Captain|Captain]] [[Rex]] and [[Clone Commander|Commander]] [[Cody]] to [[Battle of Lola Sayu|rescue]] [[Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell]], who was being held captive in the [[Citadel]] on [[Lola Sayu]]. Although the mission was successful, the shuttle itself was destroyed by [[BX-series droid commando]]s manning defense turrets.<ref name="The Citadel">{{TCW|The Citadel (episode)}}</ref>

Later, [[Count]] [[Dooku]] and [[bounty hunter]]s led by [[Cad Bane]], [[Moralo Eval]], and Obi-Wan Kenobi posing as [[Rako Hardeen]], used another escort shuttle to [[Naboo]] in an attempt to capture [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]]. However, it was revealed that the bounty hunters were merely a diversion to distract Republic troops, while Dooku lured Anakin and Palpatine to the dinner room. Although Anakin foiled the plot, Dooku used the shuttle to escape from Naboo once more.<ref name="Crisis">{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref>

Several Type B escort shuttles were parked in a [[Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel]] that was infiltrated by Jedi Generals Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker during an attempt to rescue the [[kyber crystal]]. However, Obi-Wan Kenobi destroyed the crystal instead, leading to the destruction of the shuttles as both Jedi escaped along with [[General]] [[Grievous]].<ref name="The Big Bang">{{TCW|The Big Bang}}</ref>
